properties.value:

connected. With this option, the detection can be overridden (1=CRT1 ON,

properties.name: syft:metadata:parameters:forcecrt2type:description
properties.value:
If this option is omitted, the driver autodetects CRT2 output devices, such as
LCD, TV or secondary VGA. With this option, this autodetection can be
overridden. Possible parameters are LCD, TV, VGA or NONE. NONE disables CRT2.
On systems with a SiS video bridge, parameters SVIDEO, COMPOSITE or SCART can
be used instead of TV to override the TV detection. Furthermore, on systems
with a SiS video bridge, SVIDEO+COMPOSITE, HIVISION, YPBPR480I, YPBPR480P,
YPBPR720P and YPBPR1080I are understood. However, whether or not these work
depends on the very hardware in use. (default: [autodetected])

properties.name: syft:metadata:parameters:mem:description
properties.value:

for video RAM management for eg. DRM/DRI. On 300 series, the default depends
on the amount of video RAM available. If 8MB of video RAM or less is available,
the heap starts at 4096KB, if between 8 and 16MB are available at 8192KB,
otherwise at 12288KB. On 315/330/340 series, the heap size is 32KB by default.
The value is to be specified without 'KB'.

properties.name: syft:metadata:parameters:mode:description
properties.value:

eg. 1024x768x16. Other formats supported include XxY-Depth and
XxY-Depth@Rate. If the parameter is only one (decimal or hexadecimal)
number, it will be interpreted as a VESA mode number. (default: 800x600x8)

memory for the virtual screen in order to optimize scrolling performance. If
this is set to anything other than 0, sisfb will not do this and thereby 
enable the user to positively specify a virtual Y size of the screen using
fbset. (default: 0)

properties.name: syft:metadata:parameters:passthrough:description

Option to specify how to export PCI topology to guest:
 0 - (default) Hide the true PCI topology and makes the frontend
   there is a single PCI bus with only the exported devices on it.
   For example, a device at 03:05.0 will be re-assigned to 00:00.0
   while second device at 02:1a.1 will be re-assigned to 00:01.1.
 1 - Passthrough provides a real view of the PCI topology to the
   frontend (for example, a device at 06:01.b will still appear at
   06:01.b to the frontend). This is similar to how Xen 2.0.x
   exposed PCI devices to its driver domains. This may be required
   for drivers which depend on finding their hardware in certain
   bus/slot locations.
